title: King Tormax
summary: King Tormax relies on his surviving royal guards throughout the fight.
overview: King Tormax relies on his surviving royal guards throughout the fight.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Kyenka, Yetarr, Irrek and Velden are directed onto Tormax’s top-hate target as combat begins.
Every five minutes, Tormax calls the surviving guards back into the battle. Do not leave uncontrolled guards idle elsewhere.
Assign guard tanks or clear the guards before committing the raid to Tormax.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
